$schema_note: Each item is sized to close in one session. `verification` is the only path out of `active`, and the harness runs it — never the agent. Content items stop at `human_review`; a human closes them. CI re-runs every passing claim, so editing `state` by hand is detected rather than trusted. Only a human adds items.

items.behavior: Ingest job postings from a ToS-cleared source and produce market_weight per domain in content/domains.yaml, backed by a count of postings per technology.

items.notes: Must run before bulk authoring — it decides depth per domain. Check the ToS of each source first; prefer official APIs, RSS or manual export.

items.behavior: Wiki articles are chunked by heading and searchable via SQLite FTS5 with domain and topic filters; every chunk carries doc_slug and heading_path so it can be cited.
A 50-pair evaluation set measures recall@k and MRR over the wiki, and runs on every retriever or chunking change.
items.notes: This is what justifies adding embeddings later — or proves they are not needed.

items.behavior: The CLI trainer selects due questions by SM-2 scheduling and persists reviews to SQLite; a known grade sequence produces the expected intervals.

items.behavior: The answer evaluator scores each expected_answer bullet as covered/partial/missing, derives a level, and matches a 20-pair hand-labelled golden set.
items.notes: Rubric per bullet, never a 1-10 score — otherwise calibration is unprovable.

items.behavior: The importer refuses any source without commercial_ok, deduplicates against existing content, and lands items at review_status: imported with full provenance.
The caching domain has its wiki articles written, fact-checked against official sources, and its questions derived from them.
items.notes: Template item: one of these per domain, ordered by market_weight once the frequency map exists.

items.behavior: The harness owns state transitions: `make harness-activate` enforces WIP=1 and the review queue limit, `make harness-verify` runs the item's command and records the outcome, and `make harness-check --reverify` re-runs every passing claim so a hand-edited state fails CI.
